title: Unit-normalized restriction tensorator and preservation of flat-term K-flatness
statement: Let (C,J) and (D,K) be essentially (u+1)-small sites, with objects in universe u+1 and morphisms in universe u. Let g:C -> D be continuous, R and S commutative ring sheaves of size u+1, and phi:R -> g_* S. Let L on sheaves of sets be a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint to g_*, and let I be an algebraic inverse-image lift from R to RI as in [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image]. Let c:RI -> S have underlying map given by the transpose of phi through the ring-underlying isomorphism. For any additive F on module sheaves with a specified adjunction F left adjoint to module pushforward along phi, there exists a family F(M tensor N) isomorphic to FM tensor FN, for the canonical tensor of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], natural simultaneously in M and N. On sections over g(U), its forward map takes the specified module-adjunction unit of a pure tensor to the pure tensor of the two units. Moreover F on cochain complexes sends each flat-term K-flat complex to a K-flat complex with flat terms. No open extension, projection formula or cochain tensor comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tag 03EL, tensor-product pullback; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0G7E, K-flat pullback.

proof.text: Compose the specified algebraic inverse image I with scalar extension along c. Its normalized module adjunction follows from the set adjunction and the structural-map equation. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies this constructed functor F0 with the specified F. Compose the normalized tensorator of I and scalar extension, then transport through F0 isomorphic to F. Its simultaneous naturality is the transported ordinary naturality square.

For sections x,y over U, use the Cartesian sheaf of pairs as generalized section parameter and its pure tensor map z. Apply unit naturality for the set adjunction to z and to the two projections. The normalized transpose formula and the left-adjoint uniqueness formula identify the resulting scalar-insertion values with the three specified module-adjunction unit values. TransportedOrdinary_cancel and the componentwise pure-map identity then give precisely the required pure-section equation.

Apply ringed-topos pullback preservation of flat-term K-flat complexes to F0, using I and c. Transport its K-flat conclusion along the cochain isomorphism induced by F0 isomorphic to F. Transport flatness along its component isomorphisms in each degree. The same arguments cover zero rings and modules and empty sites.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03EL; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0G7E. The scalar-insertion/unit identification and transports are proved in Lean; extracted from the system-existence proof to keep compilation within the per-file limit.

theorem nativeOpenTensor_restriction_exists
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} C] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} D]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D)
    (g : C ⥤ D) [g.IsContinuous J K]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (S : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : R ⟶ (g.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u + 1} J K).obj S)
    (L : Sheaf J (Type (u + 1)) ⥤ Sheaf K (Type (u + 1)))
    (a : L ⊣ g.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1)) J K)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L]
    (RI : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (I : SheafOfModules.AlgebraicInverseImage L R RI) (c : RI ⟶ S)
    (hc : (sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{u + 1})).map c =
      I.ringUnderlying.inv ≫ (a.homEquiv
        ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{u + 1})).obj R)
        ((sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{u + 1})).obj S)).symm
        ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{u + 1})).map φ))
    (F : WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.Mod.{u + 1, u, u + 1} J R ⥤
      WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.Mod.{u + 1, u, u + 1} K S)
    (adj : F ⊣ SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u + 1} (F := g) (J := J) (K := K)
      (R := (sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj S)
      (S := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R)
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).map φ))
    [hAdd : F.Additive] :
    ∃ rho : ∀ M N : WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.Mod.{u + 1, u, u + 1} J R,
      F.obj (ordinaryTensor.{u + 1, u, u + 1} J R M N) ≅
        ordinaryTensor.{u + 1, u, u + 1} K S (F.obj M) (F.obj N),
      (∀ {M M' N N'} (f : M ⟶ M') (h : N ⟶ N'),
        F.map (ordinaryTensorHom.{u + 1, u, u + 1} J R f h) ≫ (rho M' N').hom =
          (rho M N).hom ≫ ordinaryTensorHom.{u + 1, u, u + 1} K S (F.map f) (F.map h)) ∧
      (∀ M N (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj U) (y : N.val.obj U),
        (rho M N).hom.val.app (g.op.obj U)
          ((adj.unit.app _).val.app U (tensorSection.{u + 1, u, u + 1} J R M N U x y)) =
        tensorSection.{u + 1, u, u + 1} K S (F.obj M) (F.obj N) (g.op.obj U)
          ((adj.unit.app M).val.app U x) ((adj.unit.app N).val.app U y)) ∧
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.Mod.{u + 1, u, u + 1} J R) ℤ,
        P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients → flatTerms.{u + 1, u, u + 1} J R P →
        CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
          ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ∧
        flatTerms.{u + 1, u, u + 1} K S ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
